description: The bar chart illustrates the performance ratio (in percentage) of three large language models—Llama3 (blue), Qwen2 (red), and ChatGPT (yellow)—across three distinct knowledge domains: Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The vertical axis represents the “Ratio (%)” ranging from 50 to 90, with tick marks at intervals of 10. The horizontal axis categorizes the domains, with each domain displaying three adjacent bars corresponding to the three models. In the “Movies” category, Llama3 and Qwen2 both achieve approximately 90%, while ChatGPT scores around 73%. In “Songs,” Qwen2 again leads at about 90%, followed by Llama3 at roughly 84%, and ChatGPT at approximately 62%. In “Basketball,” Llama3 scores around 67%, ChatGPT about 61%, and Qwen2 trails at approximately 57%. The chart visually suggests that Qwen2 and Llama3 generally outperform ChatGPT in these domains, with Qwen2 showing the highest performance in Movies and Songs, while Llama3 leads in Basketball. The models’ performance appears to vary significantly by domain, potentially reflecting differences in training data coverage or knowledge popularity within each category, as implied by the paper’s title.
